Excellent experience all all around
Sep 2026 • Couples
My husband and I came here for a Mexican meal because we need a little bit of a rain. The location is a little unassuming cause it’s on a side street but very attractive restaurant with a beautiful atmosphere. I can’t show you pictures of the food because as soon as it was delivered, we devoured it. We ate every single thing on our plate. The service was amazing. The prices were completely affordable. If I want Mexican food again this will be my first choice while I am in Nha Trang. I’ve never lived in Mexico, but I’ve lived all over the United States and this is absolutely the best Mexican food I’ve ever had.
